title: OBLT AW agentic assets (apm.yml extension)
description: Extension block x-oblt-aw in consumer apm.yml. Each org key (e.g. obs, docs) owns common and workflows; workflow ids match config/<org-key>/workflow-registry.json.

common.description: Assets shared by all agentic workflows for this org when no workflow-specific block exists.

workflows.description: Per-workflow assets for this org. When a workflow id is present, common is ignored entirely (override).

setup-commands.description: Shell commands run before the agentic workflow engine starts.

inputs.description: Overrides for agentic workflow inputs (kebab-case keys). Values may be scalars or *-file paths.
